facts.fact: iAfrikan reports that the BCEAO required every bank, e-money issuer and payment institution in the eight WAEMU states, Guinea-Bissau included, to connect to its PI-SPI instant payment platform by 30 June 2026, then on 25 June 2026 moved the deadline to 30 September 2026 (microfinance institutions to 30 June 2027).
facts.system: BCEAO deadline to connect to PI-SPI

systems.system: PI-SPI (Plateforme Interopérable du Système de Paiement Instantané)
systems.tiers: banks, e-money issuers, payment institutions, microfinance institutions
